page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 276 at left and running title "ALAMANNICARVM RERVM" with "CAPVT XLVIII." below it. Main text in one column: opening paragraph with decorated initial, then a heading "ORATIO VVALAFRIDI," then a paragraph, then centred lines of closing notice, then a catchword-like heading "VVALA-" at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: HÆc de copiosissima segete B. Galli virtutū memoriæ horreis gr-
ana libuit commendare, & nostris & aliorum pastibus profutura:
poterunt enim hæc plurimam diligentibus iusticiam ædificatio-
nis conferre, quia & morum honestatem insinuant & ad laudem Domini qui ita sanctos suos glorificat
devoti lectoris animum vel auditoris inflammant. Cæterum tot & tanta sunt eiusdem sancti Patris miracula, ut nec à
studiosis Scriptoribus propter copiam sui possint comprehendi, necà fastidiosis
lectoribus sine tædio & rugata fronte percurri. Ea vero huic operi tantum
inserta sunt, quæ & veracium relatione testium veritatem custodiant, & moderata brevitate nullius quamuis etiam vtilia naufiantis mentem offendant.

l.i: Obsecramus itaque te, B. Galle, Christi confessor, ut sicut sanitatem corporum meritis tuis multis te contulisse retulimus, ita nostris mentibus divinæ miserationis medelam implorare digneris. Amen.

main_text.l: Expliciunt vita & miracula S. Galli: Incipit vita S. Othmari Abbatis.

page.notes: Large decorated initial H at the start of the first paragraph. The first word of the first line is printed as "HÆc". The text "Obsecramus" in the italic paragraph is partly hard to read; the opening word is taken as printed. Headings and the closing notice are centred. The final "VVALA-" is a catchword-like hyphenated word at the right; it is treated as text, not as a catchword.
